event_summary: A red-orange liquid stream appears from an overhead spout, lands on a yellow duck-shaped toy, and spreads across the black tray around it.
raw_event_description: At the start, a yellow duck-shaped toy sits upright in the center area of a black rectangular tray beneath a red container with a blue spout. For many frames nothing visible changes in the scene. A thin red-orange stream then appears from the spout above, extends downward to the top/front of the duck, and continues flowing. The duck becomes progressively coated with red-orange liquid, especially on the head and upper body, while liquid gathers at its base and spreads outward across the tray into an irregular puddle. The puddle widens toward both sides of the tray and later covers much of the tray floor around the duck while the stream continues.

reasons: The duck-shaped toy, tray, overhead container edge, blue spout, woven cylinder, and tabletop are visible.
No liquid stream is visible at the first frame.
The duck-shaped toy is upright and unobstructed.
